component.name: Landhorse
component.summary: Manage your passwords, keyrings, PGP and SSH keys

description.p: Landhorse is a replacement for GNOME's Passwords and Keys (Seahorse) with a conventional desktop layout: a menu bar and labelled toolbar, and three panes showing the type of thing, a sortable list of that type, and the details of the selection.

ul.li: View, copy and delete passwords in your keyrings, and lock or unlock them
Browse GnuPG keys by private or public and by email address; import, export, publish to keyservers and revoke them
See your OpenSSH keys, whether they are passphrase protected, and copy their public keys
